target_customer: B2B sales reps and founders doing cold email and LinkedIn outreach
problem: Writing personalized outreach takes prospect research; CoffeeAI generated tailored emails and messages in about ten seconds.
business_model: Subscription software, Chrome extension and web app

founders.name: Will Haringa
previous_startups: Zenno Astronautics (co-founded 2017, superconducting electromagnets for space)
founders.background_notes: Took part in University of Auckland CIE programmes; Zenno won the CIE Velocity $100k Challenge. Formal degrees not stated in the sources read.

founders.name: Aryan Lobie
founders.background_notes: Data scientist at Halter and led the team behind New Zealand's first scientific satellite (launched with Rocket Lab in November 2020), per the University of Auckland article.

technical_complexity.rationale: A thin layer over large language models plus prospect data scraping, buildable by two engineers.

defensibility.rationale: Anyone with a language model API could build a similar extension within weeks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented in the sources read.

market_need_then: The YC page claims doubled response rates (a company claim); no independent demand evidence was found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline Hyper-Personalized Sales Outreach in Seconds

rebrands.why: Not stated; Segna was the data wrangling product

brand_strength.rationale: Searches show unrelated CoffeeAI products, including an iPhone barista app, so the name was confusable and no press about the brand was found.

pivots.why: Not documented; the date is between the November 2021 Segna article and the W22 batch listing

outcome_analysis: Segna raised about NZ$880K locally and a US$125K YC check in late 2021, then pivoted into AI sales outreach as CoffeeAI during Winter 2022. YC lists it inactive; a third party archive says the cause is not documented anywhere, and no founder statement or press was found, so the cause is not public.
notes: The pre-YC round is reported as NZ$880,000 from three New Zealand firms in a search result summary (outlet not opened); the University of Auckland article I opened names the investors but not amounts, so amount is null. The YC check of US$125K is stated by the University of Auckland article and in NBR and Scoop headlines. Aggregators disagree on totals (VCBacked US$500K, CB Insights US$630K for Segna). The website get-coffee.ai loads a tagline page only. A dated competitor list could not be built: Lavender's Series A and Regie's launch coverage are 2023, too late. Competitors left empty on that basis.
